title: C123E - C123E
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Malfunction in the vacuum system for brake assistance
Vacuum leaks (lines, check valve, brake booster)
Faulty brake booster or vacuum sensor
Hydraulic Boost Compensation (HBC) activated repeatedly due to loss of vacuum supply
Prolonged driving with unresolved vacuum system malfunction
stepByStepSolution: 1. VCDS / ODIS ile canlı veri grupları taranır.
2. Tesisat ve voltaj beslemeleri test edilir.
3. Gerekirse OEM yedek parça ile yenilenip adaptör sürüşü yapılır.
technicalNotes: If there is a malfunction in the vacuum system for the braking assistance, the ABS control unit activates Hydraulic Boost Compensation (HBC) to maintain braking assistance.
